items.excerpt: A year living with Alexa Plus across Echo Show, Dot and Max: Amazon's generative-AI assistant is better at running the smart home, but not yet ready to run your life - and it now comes with ads.
items.note: Alexa+ long-term review (steer allows Alexa+ reviews; not the tablet launch).

items.excerpt: Gizmodo reviews the $449 Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 AI glasses: same camera and AI feature set as before, but Meta's new Muse model is a significant upgrade to the on-glasses assistant; spatial audio arrives via the Meta AI app.
items.note: Different from 10-05 Ray-Ban Meta Audio story; hands-on review of Gen 3 hardware + Muse AI.

items.excerpt: iOS 27 brings Apple Intelligence-powered features to the Home app for HomeKit Secure Video cameras, including AI highlights of important moments and real-time updating notifications, plus 4K video support.
items.note: Shipping feature, not pre-event rumor. Related older ledger item 2026-07-08 (Apple charging for AI camera features).

items.excerpt: An unofficial tool lets Mac owners switch off Apple Intelligence and delete downloaded on-device Siri AI models; growing anti-AI pushback and storage concerns may force Apple to offer an official removal option to protect hardware sales.
items.note: Opinion/analysis framing; on-device AI model storage angle.

items.excerpt: Pixel Buds Pro 2 and Buds 2a update adds Gemini voice commands for ANC/EQ control, one-tap live translation with a Pixel phone, sleep detection auto-pause and tap-to-mute.
items.note: POSSIBLE REPEAT: ledger has 9to5google 2026-09-28 pixel-buds-gemini-controls (likely the announcement); this is the rollout. Low priority.

items.excerpt: 딥엑스가 AI 페스타 2026에서 '피지컬 AI' 전용 NPU DX-M1 전략을 공개했다. 5W 미만 엄지손톱 크기 칩으로 로봇·CCTV 등 디바이스 자체에서 AI 추론을 처리해 GPU 대비 구축비용을 최대 100분의 1로 낮춘다고 밝혔다.
items.note: Korean on-device/edge AI NPU; check vs existing zdnet.co.kr/20261006151941 (AI Festa) for overlap.

items.excerpt: CNET interviews the founders of Dubai-based Xpanceo, which has spent five years building AI-powered smart contact lenses - 'an AI helper directly on your cornea' - that could arrive as soon as 2030.
items.note: Future-device interview; AI substantive in body.
